# EitBiz

> Full-service software development company specializing in mobile apps (iOS/Android), web applications, and eCommerce solutions using ReactJS, Next.js, Python, and WordPress.

Founded by Vikas Dagar, EitBiz (Extrovert Information Technology) has delivered 750+ projects across 700+ clients over 8+ years, with offices in USA, UK, France, UAE, India, and Australia. The company focuses on full-stack development, MVP services for startups, and AI-driven digital transformation.

## Key Topics

- Mobile app development (iOS & Android)
- Full-stack development (MEAN, MERN, LAMP)
- ReactJS & Next.js web applications
- eCommerce development (Shopify, Magento)
- MVP development for startups
- AI integration & digital transformation
- Cross-platform development (Flutter, React Native)
- WordPress & CMS solutions
- API integration & REST APIs
- Enterprise application development
- Progressive Web Apps (PWA)
- SaaS development
- Responsive design & UX
- App maintenance & optimization
